scope: Exactly nine candidates from ai\candidates.json with skill design-and-implement-retrieval-augmented-generation-rag. No other skill or author's candidates were technically reviewed or edited.
decisionBasis: Actual frozen MCP bodies and real credential/course/path HTML references were read independently. Each option was reasoned about before mechanical serialization. Technical verification is not a third-pass, rubric, final-ledger or gameplay approval.

holdReasons.reason: The captured REST reference establishes Azure SQL support, default enablement, permissions and exact behavior but never affirmatively classifies the named feature as GA or Preview. The training does not supply that classification either. Default enablement, an Applies to header, absence of a Preview warning and curator GA metadata are not substituted for the task's affirmative lifecycle requirement.
holdReasons.repairAdvice: Supply actual credential-admitted official release/lifecycle evidence for this exact Azure SQL Database feature and preserve its provenance and source snapshot in authored citations. This pass performs no re-fetch or source edit. Do not assert Preview without evidence or relabel a named API Not applicable. Any authored source/field change requires fresh generation and both subsequent independent passes.

holdReasons.reason: The complete solution is ceil(40/5)=8 calls and 12-8=4 available slots, with every limit and reservation supplied. Alternatives visibly exceed a cap or use more calls. Recognizing that retries/timeouts do not add workers is not Advanced architecture design.
holdReasons.repairAdvice: Relabel this problem Intermediate, or independently author a genuinely deeper documented design/troubleshooting problem. A difficulty-only edit still changes authored content and requires all three fresh passes; do not reuse the current fingerprint.

holdReasons.reason: The sole training citation supports the answer path and scalar/object distinction but supplies no release/lifecycle qualification for the named JSON functions. Product references used by another candidate are not automatically part of this candidate's evidence.
holdReasons.repairAdvice: Integrate the already retrieved guide/training-referenced JSON_VALUE and JSON_QUERY product sources with their actual supported-version scope and exact snapshots into a new authored citation record. Recheck scope, dates and ancestry; perform fresh generation and both reviews. Do not borrow another candidate's approval or relabel named APIs Not applicable.

difficultyAssessment.reason: Introductory application of changing records and request traceability; no advanced model engineering is claimed.
Low-end Advanced: trace escaping and nested constructors while preserving array shape and scalar content; JSON_QUERY is a substantive near-miss.
Low-end applied parameter-contract discrimination. A future repair should explicitly name the system procedure in the stem.
Apply separate root, cardinality and null-preservation controls to a complete query.
Distinguish procedure return code, HTTP metadata and application answer sufficiency.
Two supplied numeric budgets and routine retry/timeout recognition do not justify Advanced.
Two decoding layers interact with bounded scalar extraction, typed projection and JSON-array fragments.
Trace dotted aliases and two wrapper controls from complete literal SQL.
Low-end path/type discrimination, not equivalent to 032's additional parse.

technicalBoundaries.retrievalAndTraining: 026 is genuinely non-feature methodology. Request-relevant records and their identifiers support context/traceability; RAG is not retraining and does not itself guarantee freshness, privacy, authorization or truth.
technicalBoundaries.promptAndContext: 027 stipulates messages-array/string-content shape. The teaching example's named model/API/max_tokens/temperature combination was not treated as a verified service contract. No candidate asserts a numeric token budget; short fixed content is not a general context-window promise. Formatting is not a prompt-injection defense.
technicalBoundaries.transport: Read HTTPS support, Azure SQL versus SQL Server enablement, EXECUTE ANY EXTERNAL ENDPOINT, credential REFERENCES, protocol/host/path matching, allowed endpoint domains, payload/header/output roles, retryable HTTP list and outbound limits. Successful configured calls in fixtures do not require deployment code. No blanket authentication or managed-identity guarantee was inferred.
technicalBoundaries.json: Checked null omission/retention, default array/root, dotted aliases, constructor escaping, scalar/fragment extraction, JSON-in-string decoding and nvarchar(max) AS JSON. 032 bounds JSON_VALUE and supplies a compatible OPENJSON level. No native-json RETURNING or wildcard extension is inferred.
technicalBoundaries.lifecycle: Positive GA checks for classic FOR JSON and JSON_VALUE/JSON_QUERY/OPENJSON use the cited product references' established SQL Server 2016+ and Azure SQL scope for those exact nvarchar/text operations. REST maturity has no comparable affirmative evidence in these receipts and is held; training-only JSON lifecycle is also held. No source curator status is treated as proof.
technicalBoundaries.sourceLimitations: The retrieved training contains stronger freshness/privacy/model-behavior generalizations and simplified call/error examples. These are not adopted as guarantees. Product contracts determine exact behavior, and lifecycle gaps remain explicit.
